Supply and Delivery#060.src: Bring the supply crate to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#061.src: Ah, hello! What can I do for you today?
Supply and Delivery#061.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#062.src: Ah... So you do. I thought I had sent Ope to pick that up...
Supply and Delivery#062.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#063.src: More of his shenanigans, I suppose. I am sorry you have had to deal with him twice.
Supply and Delivery#063.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#064.src: When he returns to the village, I'm going to need to have a word with him... Ah, but of course, I should pay you for your troubles.
Supply and Delivery#064.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#065.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
Supply and Delivery#065.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#066.src: You may feel free to use it whenever you like! As thanks for all you have done for us.
Supply and Delivery#066.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#067.src: He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who was unfortunately killed by spiders some time ago.
Supply and Delivery#067.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#068.src: With his father out of the picture, I had to take him in. He's a grown man now, yes, but... I fear the loss has taken a toll on us both.
Supply and Delivery#068.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#069.src: I truly hope he will cease with these ridiculous ploys sometime soon... but I can't bring myself to do more than give him a stern talking to.
Supply and Delivery#069.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#070.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. It's alright if you don't feel the same way, though. I will not force you to interact with him if you do not wish to.
Supply and Delivery#070.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#071.src: Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
Supply and Delivery#071.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#072.src: He was a kind man, always looking out for the townsfolk. Though, by the time he retired, it was clear he was growing restless in our little town.
Supply and Delivery#072.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#073.src: Well, as soon as he passed down the position to me, he immediately traveled to {p} and enlisted in their army! I hear he's in the business of training soldiers these days.
Supply and Delivery#073.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#074.src: Ah, but I've tried lived up to his legacy. I like to think I've done well in my time as mayor!
Supply and Delivery#074.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#075.src: A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
Supply and Delivery#075.speaker: Mayor Alvin
